svg.title: SPY candles for 2026-09-03, 09:30 to 16:00 ET
svg.desc: One candle per observed minute, 09:30 to 16:00 ET: body from open to close, wick from high to low. Breaks mark missing source intervals: 13:54–13:55 ET. No axes; vertical scale is relative to this session. No stretch of this session has been reviewed for execution, so every candle is neutral. Candles are never coloured by whether the price rose or fell. Marcelo's net result that day: Unrecorded.
